name: Step-Up Security Success
summary: An authenticated user attempts to enter a protected application area or perform a protected operation, is required to provide fresh approved MFA proof, successfully satisfies that challenge, and continues without changing durable identity.
finalOutcome: The current authenticated identity has fresh MFA assurance sufficient for the protected area or operation, and the user may continue the originally requested activity.

sourceReferences.note: Existing passkey journey is evidence for one mechanism that can satisfy step-up security.
Protected application areas require an MFA capability; the canonical behavior is independent of the factor used.
